notes: Pricing wall time excludes capture loading and flight-graph construction; includes initial GPU runtime creation where applicable.
First-use and repeated calls share graph/view objects; each process shares a runtime across flights. These are not independent cold-process trials per flight.
Initial preparation, future preparation and search stages are distinct. Runtime, allocation, wait and GPU execution timers overlap; do not add them.
Transfer metrics count host/device copy bytes, not discrete transfer time. Metal shared-memory copies are counted.
Allocated records sum preliminary/full/retry passes; the 250000 label cap applies per pass.
Hard88 comparisons are single serialized replays, not statistical performance estimates.
Compare incumbent reduced costs and valid upper bounds; equal-quality routes may differ.
CUDA source/interface checks only; no NVIDIA hardware validation.

joint_bound_diagnostic.description: Price-only hop-constrained suffix with endpoint/origin rows reserved, combined with full positive prefix, unpaid endpoint arrival minimum and clamped geometry. Three diagnostic variants all produced no new closures.

validation.solver_scope: Canonical full solver on ten-flight original-capture subset; not the full 1537-flight workload.
